events.what: Web Summit announces it will leave Dublin for Lisbon from 2016; Silicon Republic reports infrastructure among the reasons.
Opening night of the first Lisbon edition: ticket holders left outside; the site says 53,056 attending.
TheJournal.ie reports the Prime Minister's criticism of the founders' dinner at the National Pantheon and the organiser's apology.
Web Summit's founder withdraws the invitation to Marine Le Pen to the 2018 Lisbon edition; TheJournal.ie reports it.

During the online 2020 edition, Web Summit's expansion plans are reported: RISE in Kuala Lumpur and Web Summit Tokyo in 2022, an event in Brazil to be placed, and an in-person Lisbon edition planned for November 2021.
Web Summit's CEO resigns after remarks about the Israel-Hamas conflict; several companies had withdrawn from the 2023 Lisbon edition; the company says it will go ahead.
Web Summit appoints Katherine Maher as chief executive, two weeks before the 2023 Lisbon edition.
Web Summit announces its chief executive will step down on 1 March 2024 to lead NPR, remaining as non-executive chair.
